newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds, bank stocks lead post-budget rally.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds, bank stocks lead post-budget rally.

text.p: Lloyds TSB Group Plc and other banking groups rose on Thursday, leading a sharp swing-round in the UK's FTSE 100 index in frantic post-Budget trade.

Dealers said banks remained in favour for their domestic earnings, insulated from the effects of sterling strength, for their strong financial position and for the prospects of further bids and mergers in the industry.
Lloyds was up 10-1/2p at 656-1/2 by 0849 GMT in volume of almost three million shares, after earlier rising as much as 27p.
Barclays Plc was up 18-1/2p at 12.31 stg, Abbey National Plc was up 30-1/2p at 892-1/2, Halifax Plc was up 4p at 771-1/2 and National Westminster Bank Plc was up 24-1/2p at 884.
